qa.qualification: The full inverse/application/build checks followed radial generation. Subsequent changes are offline annotation/scoring helpers, covered by ten Python tests, seven focused Node tests including a real lower-resolution CLI replay, and lint. Application and static runtime sources are unchanged.

benchmark.scope: Six inspected development designs, first instance of each style at 3/5/8 lobes and first photographic view. Exact masks and ground-truth crops are explicit diagnostic interventions; only the automatic track is a blind photograph upload. No cutting paths, cut count or graph enters fitting.
benchmark.correction: Original photographic comparisons/writes incorrectly assumed 400px. These regenerated inputs must match the original source-mask hash; saved cuts are unchanged and independently rendered at the actual prepared resolution. Fitting is not rerun. Only original solver timings and engine reports are retained, not the invalid derived scores.
benchmark.visualReview: All six panels of input/woven/latent masks across three tracks were inspected, plus all three browser result/Draw pairs. Photographic corners are rounded relative to ideal polygons. Thin source-edge artifacts remain in several automatic crops. No extra slit was introduced in these six designs.
limits: Six development cases from one simple procedural recipe, not six new real-photo recoveries or a full 64-design benchmark.
Ten seconds is the native search allowance; solve timings exclude crop detection, scoring and artifact writes.
The canonical mask and known-crop tracks use explicit synthetic ground truth; only the automatic track is a blind upload.
Rescoring retains the exact original input-mask hashes and exported cuts. Initial dimension-mismatched scores are invalid and not counted.
No neural training, held-out generalization claim, original-cut uniqueness claim or physical assembly test.
